summary: Comprehensive architectural and product plan for Chapter 7: The Legend of Zelda — Ocarina of Time in Hollowmere, featuring a 10x expanded 10-Act main quest campaign (~120 quest steps) across all iconic Hyrule overworld regions, 3 Spiritual Stone dungeons, 6 Sage Temples, Ganon's Castle, playable Ocarina of Time songs, Epona and Loftwing mounts, and Tier 9 Hylian weapons and tunics.
